text.title: Marugoto A2-1 Learning App
text.description: A learning application for the Marugoto A2-1 course.
text.notification: It's time to review your lessons :)
text.config_desc: Welcome to the configuration menu, here you can:
text.temporizer_SRS: Set a reminder for a specific time and date or disable
text.light_mode: Set the light mode of the app
text.dark_mode: Set the dark mode of the app
text.language: Set the language of the lessons and interface (Currently only Spanish and English)
text.temporizer_coming_soon: Our apologies, it seems that this function isn't available at the time, please check if there's a new version supporting it!
